children: Gold prices declined on Monday, September 14, as the 21-karat gold recorded EGP 6,240.4 for buying and EGP 6,174.18 for selling.
The 24-karat price recorded EGP 7,131.17 for purchase and EGP 7,055.5 for sale, according to Dahab Masr data at 3:36 PM.
Globally, the international ounce reached $4,280.6 for buying and $4,279.8 for selling.

title: ZAWYA: Gold prices in Egypt fall on September 14
